title: How to Play
subtitle: This is how Picks4All works — from prediction to podium
description: Discover how the platform works step by step. From making your prediction to watching live results and competing on the leaderboard.

prediction.title: 1. Make your prediction
prediction.description: Before each match, predict the final score. Select goals for each team and save your prediction before the deadline.
prediction.note: The deadline is set when creating the pool (e.g., 10 minutes before kickoff).

liveResults.title: 2. Live results
liveResults.description: During the match, scores update automatically. You can watch the progress live directly in your pool.

scoring.title: 3. How your points are calculated
scoring.description: There are 3 suggested scoring systems. The Host picks one or combines them — scoring is fully customizable.

predictor.name: Predictor
predictor.description: Earn points for each criterion you get right: outcome, home goals, away goals, goal difference, and exact score. The more accurate, the more points.

basic.name: All or Nothing
basic.description: Get 20 points if you nail the exact score. Otherwise, 0 points. Simple and direct.

strategist.name: Strategist
strategist.description: Predict which team wins the group, who advances, and who wins the tournament. No exact scores needed.

scoring.customNote: Want something different? The Host can combine criteria and customize the points. You have full control over how predictions are scored.
scoring.basicMissDesc: If you had predicted 3-1 and the actual result was 2-1, you get 0 points because you didn't match the exact score.

leaderboard.title: 4. Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Compete against all players in your pool. The leaderboard updates in real time after every match and can be filtered by tournament phase.
leaderboard.phaseHelp: Use the tabs to view the overall ranking or filter by tournament phase.

allMatches.title: 5. Play in ALL matches
allMatches.description: It's not just one match — you can predict in every match of the tournament, from the group stage to the final.

winners.title: 6. The winners
winners.description: At the end of the tournament, the players with the most accumulated points win. Will you be the best predictor?

cta.title: Ready to play?
cta.subtitle: Create your pool for free and start making your predictions.
